title: Breaking API change: PolicyPeriod.getLatestPeriod() renamed
details: As part of the 2025.2.1 API cleanup, PolicyPeriod.getLatestPeriod() has been renamed to PolicyPeriod.getLatestBoundPeriod() to clarify semantics. Custom Gosu rules referencing the old method name will throw GosuRuntimeException at runtime. Customers should search custom rule sets for getLatestPeriod() prior to upgrading.

title: New SOC2-compliant audit logging interceptor
details: Introduces AuditLogInterceptor to capture all document-generation and policy-bind events for SOC2 compliance. Enabled by default. Can be disabled via gw.audit.interceptor.enabled=false if issues are observed.

title: Fix: Deadlock between AuditLogInterceptor and DocumentGenService under high concurrency
details: Resolves a lock-ordering deadlock (vendor case GW-88213) between the new audit-logging interceptor and document generation service that could cause full application unresponsiveness under high concurrent load. Customers who disabled gw.audit.interceptor.enabled as a workaround may safely re-enable it after applying 2025.2.2.

title: Autopay data model migration: cg_autopayenabled_legacy deprecated
details: The legacy cg_autopayenabled_legacy boolean field is deprecated in favor of the new cg_autopayenrollment entity, which supports multiple payment methods per account. Any custom batch jobs or reports filtering on the legacy field must be migrated before this field is removed in a future release.

title: Performance improvements to claim activity retrieval APIs
details: Underlying activity retrieval APIs now support batch fetch by claim_id list to reduce N+1 query patterns in custom widgets. Existing custom widgets must be updated to use the new batch API to benefit; the old per-row API remains available but is now marked deprecated.

title: Advisory: Rate table refactor changes discount comparison operators
details: As part of the rating engine refactor shipped in 2025.2.1, several bundled discount rule templates were regenerated from updated rate tables. Guidewire recommends re-running backtest suites against sample quotes for any customized discount rules derived from these templates, as comparison operators in generated code may differ subtly from prior versions.
